pid=3287 cwd=/workspace :: node /usr/local/bin/pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:serve 
pid=3304 cwd=/workspace :: node /workspace/node_modules/.bin/../nx/dist/bin/nx.js run sva-studio-react:serve 
pid=4005 cwd=/workspace :: /usr/bin/timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 600s /bin/bash -lc set -o pipefail
cd /workspace || exit 125
for pid in $(pgrep -f 'node' | sort); do
  cwd=$(readlink /proc/$pid/cwd 2>/dev/null)
  cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-90)
  case "$cmd" in
    *vite*|*nitro*|*sva-studio-react*|*node_modules/.bin*) echo "pid=$pid cwd=$cwd :: $cmd
  esac
done 2>/dev/null | head -20
